body.name: Blind ratio target and total drift
body.construction: Set \(\bar p_i=m^{-1}\sum_{j\in J}E_P[p_{ij}]=m^{-1}\sum_{j\in J}E_P[A_{ij}]\), \(\widehat p_i=\Pi_{[q/2,1-q/2]}(m^{-1}\sum_{j\in J}A_{ij})\), \(M^{\mathrm B}_{ij}=p_{ij}\mu^1_{ij}/\bar p_i-(1-p_{ij})\mu^0_{ij}/(1-\bar p_i)\), \(H^{\mathrm B}_{ij}=p_{ij}\mu^1_{ij}/\bar p_i^2+(1-p_{ij})\mu^0_{ij}/(1-\bar p_i)^2\), \(D^{\mathrm B}_{ij}=-(\widehat p_i-\bar p_i)H^{\mathrm B}_{ij}\), and \(T^{\mathrm B}=M^{\mathrm B}+D^{\mathrm B}\). Let \(U^{\mathrm O}\) and \(U^{\mathrm B}\) be the leading \(r\) left singular matrices of \(M^{\mathrm B}\) and \(T^{\mathrm B}\), respectively, under the fixed tie rule, and set \(\rho_{nm}=\mathcal L(U^{\mathrm B},U)\).
inputs: The law, propensity path, assignments, and conditional arm means.
